transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the importance of security and privacy in the ATM system. TRU-01 ensures that all transactions are encrypted during transmission, safeguarding sensitive data. TRU-02 mandates secure PIN authentication, crucial for access control. TRU-03 requires logging transactions for auditability, while TRU-04 prevents negative balances, protecting users from financial mishaps. TRU-05 allows users to review their transaction history securely, enhancing transparency. TRU-06 ensures users are notified of insufficient funds, preventing unauthorized transactions. Finally, TRU-07 maintains data integrity, validating operations against business rules. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy ATM system.

GRN-04 focuses on minimizing data storage requirements, reducing the environmental impact of data centers. GRN-05 offers clients an eco-friendly option for receiving transaction records. GRN-06 promotes energy savings by shutting down during inactivity. Finally, GRN-07 ensures annual assessments of environmental impact, fostering continuous improvement in sustainability practices.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the critical importance of safety and reliability in the ATM system. requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall ensure user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The system shall implement load balancing to manage transaction requests effectively.
The system shall allow limited withdrawals during system maintenance.
